title: Poset reindexing preserving cardinal filteredness
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal U$; sets and indexing categories called small belong to $\mathcal U$, and all Hom sets are small. An infinite cardinal $\eta$ is regular when a union of fewer than $\eta$ sets of cardinality less than $\eta$ has cardinality less than $\eta$. A category is $\eta$-filtered when every diagram with fewer than $\eta$ morphisms admits a cocone; for a poset this means that every subset of cardinality less than $\eta$, including the empty subset, has an upper bound. An object is $\eta$-presentable when its Hom functor preserves small $\eta$-filtered colimits. Let $\eta$ be infinite regular and $I$ a small $\eta$-filtered category. There are a small $\eta$-filtered partially ordered set $P$ and a functor $u:P\to I$ with the following property: for every category $\mathcal C$, every diagram $D:I\to\mathcal C$, and every colimit cocone $(L,(\iota_i))$ on $D$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], the restricted cocone $(L,(\iota_{u(p)}))$ on $D\circ u$ is a colimit. The same $P,u$ work for every $\mathcal C,D,L$.
